snippet.title: The Pit (Ketchapp)
snippet.description:
iOS : https://itunes.apple.com/app/the-pit/id1065906948?at=11lGxL&ct=youtube-thepit

Android : https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ketchapp.thepit

Run, jump, and slide your way through The Pit!

Watch out for deadly traps as you race against the most dangerous terrain.  
Choose to play as multiple characters by collecting coins to unlock new ones. Compete with your friends for the highest score. 

How far can you go? 

Features: 

→ Unlock cool new Characters 
→ Fast action One Touch Gameplay
→ Challenge your Friends for the High Score  
→ Extremely Fun & Addicting!

How to Play:

1. Tap and hold to slide. 
2. Release to Jump
3. Tap again to Double Jump
